name: display_build_tool_preview
notes: Traces the REAL linked C port (display_tool_preview.c + display.c + browser_redact.c + libjson) with the result folded as a V-event, so preview text must match LIVE byte-for-byte. Inputs restricted to branches where the port is faithful: browser_exec, skill_view, and delegate_task action=list/steer/stop rungs are absent from the C port and are deliberately not exercised. KNOWN DIVERGENCE (documented, not exercised): for an EMPTY args dict ({}) LIVE returns None immediately (`if not args`) while the C port parses {} as a valid object and walks the full dispatch ladder.
